name: monkey-see-monkey-do-mobile
description: iOS and Android app shells (Capacitor) for Monkey See, Monkey Do

scripts.android:debug: node ../scripts/build_web.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: node ../scripts/build_web.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:open: node ../scripts/build_web.mjs && cap sync ios && cap open ios
